about.title: Digital habits.
about.description: Computers are part of almost everything we do at work, but we rarely think about the energy and resources they use.
about.caption: A research project at LUT University, exploring a desktop companion that helps people understand their digital habits and make more sustainable everyday choices.

card.tag: A companion for your digital life

challenge.title: The hidden cost
challenge.description: Our digital activities may seem invisible, but the energy and resources they consume are very real.
challenge.caption: Computers can continue consuming energy even when we're not using them. Background applications keep running, and files we no longer need take up storage space. These are everyday habits we rarely think about, but they can add up over time.

card.tag: The impact we don’t always see

solution.title: Understand your impact.
solution.description: A clearer picture of energy, storage, and digital behaviour. Thoughtful guidance for what to do next.
solution.caption: We're developing a desktop companion that helps people better understand their digital habits. By monitoring selected activities, calculating a Digital Sustainability Score, and offering practical recommendations, it aims to help users make more sustainable choices in their everyday computer use.
